channel.description: Latest articles from Hoover Sun LLC (hooversun.com)

item.title: Ambient artists Luke Schneider and Saapato bring immersive sounds to Hoover Library Plaza
item.description: Two innovative musicians working at the forefront of ambient and experimental music will make their Hoover debuts as part of the Hoover Public Library’s Live on the Plaza series.

item.title: Hoover Small Business Alliance breakfast rescheduled to March 11
item.description: Hoover Mayor Nick Derzis will be doing a question-and-answer session.

item.title: Bargains on the Bluff returns with shopping, savings and support for local children
item.description: Bluff Park United Methodist Church will host its spring Bargains on the Bluff consignment sale Feb. 19-21, featuring gently used clothing, toys and more, with proceeds benefiting Vacation Bible School and Bluff Park Preschool.

item.title: Test your luck at bingo night at the Hoover Public Library
item.description: Adults are invited to enjoy an evening of bingo, prizes and friendly competition Feb. 12 at the Hoover Public Library.

item.title: Hoover City Council changes reserve fund policy for more flexibility

item.title: Shades Mountain Elementary honored for Blue Ribbon School status
item.description: The Trump administration canceled the program before a national ceremony could be held.

item.title: Celebrate the art of beautiful writing at the Birmingham Calligraphy Guild Expo
item.description: The Birmingham Calligraphy Guild Expo returns to the Hoover Public Library on Feb. 14 with live demonstrations, hands-on activities and stunning examples of calligraphy on display.

item.title: Telling yourself the truth: How writing became healing for Levi Stowe
item.description: Once a punishment, writing became Levi Stowe’s refuge. Through foster care and hardship, he found healing on the page, using honesty and satire to process pain and encourage others to begin their own stories.

item.title: Band students from Hoover schools picked for honor bands, shows
item.description: Hoover High senior Cameron Gordon was selected for the Bands of America Honor Band in the 2026 Rose Parade, highlighting a standout year of statewide and national honors for Hoover school musicians.

item.title: Celebrate Alabama’s quilting tradition with ‘Quilt of Souls’ author Phyllis Biffle Elmore Feb. 17
item.description: Phyllis Biffle Elmore and radio host Burgin Mathews will discuss Elmore’s memoir, “Quilt of Souls,” in a free program at the Hoover Public Library.
